source: Iowa Environmental Mesonet ASOS/AWOS archive (routine + special METARs)

malibu_ca.why: Camarillo sits where the Santa Ana flow leaves the Santa Clara / Conejo gaps west of the Santa Monica Mountains; Santa Monica (coast) and Van Nuys (valley) are the cross-checks

paradise_ca.why: Chico Municipal, 22 km W on the valley floor below the Paradise ridge (Oroville cross-check)

santa_rosa_ca.why: Sonoma County Airport, 14 km W of the Mark West / Fountaingrove interface

extreme.override: Tubbs Fire night, Santa Rosa RAWS 2017-10-09 11:00 UTC: wind 11.6 m/s, gust 27.3 m/s, RH 7 %, 32.8 C, FFWI 78 (Nauslar et al. 2018, Fire 1(1):18, Table 3); hold and easing as measured at Sonoma County Airport that day (anchors)

rancho_santa_fe_ca.why: Carlsbad / Palomar, 14 km NW on the same coastal mesa; Ramona (inland, upwind in a Santa Ana) is the cross-check

boulder_co.why: Boulder Municipal, 11 km NNW, under the foothills' downslope winds (Broomfield, 6 km SE on its mesa, stayed near 15 mph through the Marshall Fire); the grass fire season is year-round (Marshall burned in December)

park_city_ut.why: Heber Valley, 28 km SSE - the nearest mountain-valley airport (Park City has none); Salt Lake City, below Parleys Canyon, is the cross-check

vail_co.why: Eagle County Regional, the Eagle Valley's airport, moved up to Vail's homes; Aspen (same elevation band) cross-checks

beaver_creek_co.why: Eagle County Regional, 33 km W down the same valley

eagle_co.why: Eagle County Regional, in the community

glenwood_springs_co.why: Rifle / Garfield County, 34 km W down the Colorado River at nearly the town's elevation (Glenwood has no weather station in the archive); Eagle cross-checks

basalt_carbondale_co.why: Aspen / Sardy Field, 28 km up the same Roaring Fork Valley, moved down 380 m to the homes

aspen_co.why: Aspen / Sardy Field, in the community

eagle_vail_co.why: Eagle County Regional, at the corridor's west end, moved up to the corridor homes' median elevation
